question: A group of ribosomes attached to mRNA is known as _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**polysomes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Ribosomes of a Polysome 

 
 
• The cellular organelles known as ribosomes are made up of proteins and rRNA.
 
• Before they bind to mRNA, they are present free in the cytoplas
